Title: Users may be unable to generate images in Microsoft 365 Copilot Create

User impact: Users may have been unable generate images in Copilot Create.

Final status: We identified that a recent feature update included a misconfiguration in the Create module that led to this impact. We've reverted the change and confirmed through our own testing that this has resolved the impact.

Scope of impact: This issue may have affected Copilot Create users attempting to generate images.

Start time: Friday, October 30, 2026, at 7:00 PM UTC

End time: Monday, November 2, 2026, at 5:40 PM UTC

Root cause: A recent feature update included a misconfiguration in the Create module, which led to this impact.

Next steps: 
- We're reviewing our feature configuration testing and validation phases to pinpoint and implement areas for improvement to prevent similar future impact from occurring.

This is the final update for the event.
